hooks.command: for file in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do case "$file" in *.pb.go|*_ttrpc.pb.go) echo "BLOCKED: Cannot edit generated protobuf file: $file"; echo 'To modify, edit the .proto file and run: task protos'; exit 2;; esac; done
for file in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do case "$file" in *.pb.go) ;; *.go) gofmt -w "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; goimports -w "$file" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; done
